data.value: Your living persona's Sleaze decreases by 1. This quality requires a technomancer and weakens that one Matrix attribute, not Resonance or all four persona attributes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.08c4dfad-3661-48d9-a265-43cce84e20d8
data.value: Choose this only during creation. Up to 1 Essence worth of bioware marked as part of your prototype does not reduce your Essence; the bioware still costs nuyen. You must also take one of these drawbacks without gaining extra Karma: Wanted, a common mild Allergy, Astral Beacon, or basic Insomnia. This is not a general Essence discount for all later augmentations.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b0321887-df33-49d9-9d2e-e718eca9c7a0
data.value: For an infected runner, this offers a choice of one optional infected power, such as Armor, an Enhanced Sense, or Regeneration. These are alternatives, not powers you receive together. A separate optional drawback can affect the cost. The chosen power's full effect and the final discount still need their own explanation; the quality's listed zero cost does not promise a free power.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.71511c8f-85f1-4e35-aeaa-be8fa3a45331
data.value: As a technomancer, you can permanently fetter one sprite, giving that sprite unlimited services. This permits the bond; it does not grant a free sprite. In Career, fettering costs Karma equal to the sprite's rating, and only one entity may be fettered at a time. This stream cannot be combined with the other listed Resonant or Dissonant streams.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d2873478-d265-45bb-8a9f-320b8d0d33d3
data.value: As a technomancer, add two dice when Compiling or Decompiling a Fault or Companion sprite. These are alternative targets, not a four-die bonus. During submersion, your daemon can help recover Resonance lost to cyberware, subject to the character's current limits and rules settings. It does not refund Essence or undo bioware loss. This stream excludes the other listed Resonant and Dissonant streams.

data.name: Qualities.Info.ChangedDefinition
data.value: This quality uses a different definition. Its full explanation is not available yet; any effects below come from this version.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.68cfe94a-fa7e-4129-a9b9-b5d73e3ced99
data.value: Using your off hand no longer incurs the off-hand penalty. This does not add dice to every attack or remove penalties for splitting your attention between multiple actions.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.7d81f676-e523-4ec6-ae98-8d801f90b031
data.value: Your magical traces fade twice as quickly. Anyone assensing a signature you left takes a two-die penalty. This conceals your astral traces, not your physical presence, and requires the ability to leave magical signatures.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9cffd452-8489-48d5-888c-ac35459d9174
data.value: You are hard to remember: recalling your details needs one extra hit. Following or finding you among people, including asking about your appearance, takes a two-die penalty. Magical and Matrix searches are unaffected. Distinctive features or surroundings where you stand out can remove the benefit.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4d5c22b9-4908-493d-a6f7-4ccc3066888c
data.value: Sustain one spell or complex form without its usual sustaining penalty, provided its Force or level does not exceed this quality's rating. Additional sustained effects still impose their normal penalties. This does not waive Drain or Fading.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5c18a150-8e38-4f6d-b4f5-b1b674a3581e
data.value: In vehicle combat or a chase, choose 20% more Speed or +1 Handling for your vehicle or drone. Gain two dice for difficult maneuvers and stunts. The boost lasts 1D6 minutes; extending it by up to another 1D6 minutes causes one unresisted stress-damage point per extra minute.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0d0cb0fc-c79d-418e-9216-8a197369e52d
data.value: Add two dice when resisting fear or intimidation, including fear caused by magic or creature powers. This helps you keep your nerve; it does not make you immune or improve your own Intimidation attacks.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2844e64e-f271-4ca7-bd58-0860b2db56c9
data.value: An elf, dwarf or ork can usually pass for human. Human prejudice against metahumans is treated as neutral in social tests, but people hostile to humans may react worse. Your actual metatype and its attributes do not change.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.27c7ea84-bfe4-47e1-8382-38d9a5c8e680
data.value: For improvised mechanical fixes, gain two dice and reduce the required hits by one. The GM decides what is feasible. Results are temporary, not permanent upgrades. Combining a vehicle-performance fix with Gearhead burns out its critical components when the boost ends.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.52648a83-1d2a-4b04-b7fc-ee5a62bce4f7
data.value: Your nervous system provides one point of natural biofeedback filtering. It stacks with a Biofeedback Filter program or a technomancer's Firewall. This protects against biofeedback, not ordinary physical attacks.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.de12b672-f60a-486d-85f6-b94a80a058da
data.value: External technology malfunctions around you. Each level lowers the number of rolled ones needed for a glitch by one, with a minimum of one. Implants are unaffected; this cannot be used to sabotage enemies. The GM may require a roll for normally automatic device use. Notoriety increases once, not per level.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ced3fecf-2277-4b20-b1e0-894162ca9ae2
data.value: Choose a magical guide with its own benefits and demands. The chosen mentor and the eligible bonus choices determine what you gain; you do not receive every mentor's bonuses. The individual mentor's benefits and drawbacks are not yet fully described here.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c5311ee0-8a9b-41b9-857f-28541090968a
data.value: A technomancer chooses a Paragon as a Resonance guide. Its profile determines the benefits, drawbacks and any follow-up choices; this is not a universal dice bonus or a free sprite. The individual Paragon's rules are not yet fully described here.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.36429e96-89fa-4e37-a20a-61a8d35a92ac
data.value: For an A.I. character, choose one eligible inherent program. The selected program supplies its own function and may require an additional detail. This is a program choice, not a bonus to all Matrix actions; the selected program's effects are not yet fully described here.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.94a09a8d-d582-44f0-9f2c-71f7ba94e767
data.value: Your astral signatures linger twice as long. Anyone examining one with Assensing needs one fewer hit to learn about it. This changes the information threshold, not their dice pool. Only characters with Magic can take this drawback.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.bc5f41ca-1549-4367-9c12-afa403182f8c
data.value: Whenever you spend Edge, roll one die. On a 1, the Edge is spent but its intended benefit backfires: for example, extra dice become lost dice, or canceling a glitch causes a critical glitch. This reversal can happen only once per session; afterward, stop making this check that session.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.62c7ed8f-b534-41e3-84ac-29534826d476
data.value: At the start of combat, halve your first Initiative score, rounding up. Later Initiative tests are normal. Surprise tests lose three dice. Composure tests under fire or in combat need one extra hit. This halves the opening score, not your Initiative dice or every later round.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.86b259fd-17c8-4ae5-b246-49782e7c5047
data.value: Choose one Matrix action that requires a test. Whenever you attempt that action, lose two dice. You cannot choose an action with no test or a hacking action you would never realistically attempt. Other Matrix actions are unaffected.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.a030d7e2-755b-4f71-b848-ad9772fba242
data.value: Your memorable look or behavior makes you easier to identify, trace or locate: relevant searches and legwork gain two dice. Remembering details about you needs one fewer hit, minimum one. Astral searches are unaffected. This quality can be taken only once and cannot combine with Blandness.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0cf25fda-725b-49fd-a8cf-de589e938065
data.value: Before Stun recovery, test Intuition + Willpower (4). Failure doubles each recovery interval to two hours and postpones Edge refresh up to 24 hours. Success allows normal recovery.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.149e6bf7-a6b4-4893-b755-4d983372079c
data.value: Before Stun recovery, test Intuition + Willpower (4). Failure prevents any healing from that rest attempt; try later. Edge refresh waits 24 hours. Success allows normal recovery.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b2210e9a-ab8a-45f9-b5db-13f6923c2d22
data.value: Augmented reality, virtual reality and simsense disorient you. Tests while interacting with them lose two dice; smartlinks, simrigs and image links are included. This is not a permanent penalty to unrelated tests without those interfaces.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9ba327d2-38c5-4a25-ae44-25e98f0bbf03
data.value: Pain impairs you sooner. For Physical damage and for Stun damage, suffer a one-die wound penalty for every two filled boxes instead of every three. This changes when wound penalties increase, not the size of either condition monitor.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.7036225b-d0f0-4c86-85b7-cc4d46943113
data.value: As a human, you imitate elves through appearance and behavior. Passing as an elf can avoid prejudice against non-elves, but discovery can provoke elven hostility and stigma from prejudiced humans. This quality is human-only; neither your actual metatype nor its attributes change.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.075447a2-5730-4750-a19f-1a5c6086903d
data.value: As a human or elf, you imitate orks through cosmetic changes and behavior. Discovery may provoke hostility or make acceptance depend on hazing and proving yourself. Prejudiced members of your own metatype may also reject you. You do not gain ork attributes or change your actual metatype.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.40c06974-a85b-4f2b-9558-51c140c16d87
data.value: Choose one spirit type, even outside your tradition. Those spirits harass you, resist cooperation and target you first with lethal force when ordered to attack your group. Summoning or binding that type loses two dice; it gains two dice against your Banishing. Requires magic. Watchers and other constructs do not count.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ea7cced4-a201-44a2-9a1b-e10180b1df81
data.value: Monthly craving: one dose or one hour of the habit. If withdrawal is not resisted, lose two dice on Mental-based tests for psychological dependence or Physical-based tests for physical dependence until the craving is satisfied.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9a52a300-4d90-4b1f-a113-d0e40a410063
data.value: Craving every two weeks: one dose or one hour. Withdrawal costs four dice on Mental-based tests for psychological dependence or Physical-based tests for physical dependence until satisfied. A successful withdrawal test avoids those symptoms.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b5fa94e6-03fb-4d00-b368-86c318f79c09
data.value: Weekly craving: two doses or two hours. Withdrawal: four fewer dice on Mental-based tests for psychological dependence or Physical-based tests for physical dependence. Social tests always lose two dice, even outside withdrawal.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0886bbb3-f5a9-4583-bcea-d6723889c80d
data.value: Daily craving: at least three doses or three hours. Withdrawal: six fewer dice on Mental-based tests for psychological dependence or Physical-based tests for physical dependence. Social tests always lose three dice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b7841930-0c7b-4be4-b1cf-86debc41aa95
data.value: While the allergen affects you, Physical tests lose two dice. Resisting an attack using that allergen loses one die.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e89db285-8db9-4a9c-80cb-94d87b86a80b
data.value: While the allergen affects you, Physical tests lose two dice. Resisting an attack using that allergen loses one die.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f3ad08be-a7a4-4965-bb38-f8db9016c94e
data.value: While the allergen affects you, Physical tests lose four dice. Resisting an attack using that allergen loses two dice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.90188ca7-0ccb-4198-b199-dcf33e029d74
data.value: While the allergen affects you, Physical tests lose four dice. Resisting an attack using that allergen loses two dice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.84a43000-9ae4-4391-b156-d5fbc9a092de
data.value: Exposure: all tests lose four dice; each minute causes one unresisted Physical damage box. Resisting attacks using the allergen loses three dice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.df14fb6e-456d-4d24-83e8-b1c97576dce2
data.value: Exposure: all tests lose four dice; each minute causes one unresisted Physical damage box. Resisting attacks using the allergen loses three dice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cfdc255a-bb46-4d9c-8960-e4181455f4e3
data.value: Exposure: all actions lose six dice; one unresisted Physical damage box every 30 seconds. Allergen-attack resistance loses four dice. First Aid, Medicine or magic can stop shock damage.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8a40007a-9876-4998-a7c9-047248cfbc52
data.value: Exposure: all actions lose six dice; one unresisted Physical damage box every 30 seconds. Allergen-attack resistance loses four dice. First Aid, Medicine or magic can stop shock damage.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9ac85feb-ae1e-4996-8514-3570d411e1d5
data.value: You are a registered national citizen, not anonymous. Pay 15% of gross income in tax. Your identity and biometrics are available to law enforcement through the SIN registry. You must broadcast your legal SIN; a fake identity does not erase this record.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d9479e5c-d44a-45b9-8fb4-d1e08a9487b2
data.value: Your criminal record replaces any previous SIN. Pay 15% of gross income in tax and broadcast this SIN; concealing it risks arrest. Legal jobs and access are restricted, and police may detain you for questioning. Registered magic users also face checks on their residence and magical equipment.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.318d2edd-833b-48c5-a3e1-343bf03848a5
data.value: Your corporate employment grants limited citizenship, not leadership or special-forces privileges. Pay 20% of gross income to the corporation. This SIN usually replaces a national SIN and appears in the global registry. Rivals may target you for extraction; SINless communities may distrust you even after you leave the corporation.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e00623e1-54b0-4a91-b234-3c7e141deef4
data.value: You have full corporate citizenship and pay 10% of gross income to the corporation. It retains your detailed records; the global registry only confirms SIN validity. If your background is discovered, shadow communities may assume corporate loyalty and respond with severe hostility. Citizenship does not grant free corporate resources.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d6843e67-0837-4353-a5db-f4c320560ddb
data.value: Your bias concerns a commonly encountered group you choose. Social tests with its members take -2 dice; when negotiating with you, they gain +2 dice. This is situational, not a penalty to every social interaction.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9a76f104-a472-4b6a-b5b7-a8f5248f65a9
data.value: Your openly expressed prejudice concerns a commonly encountered group you choose. Social tests with its members take -4 dice; when negotiating with you, they gain +4 dice. This is situational, not a penalty to every social interaction.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1dc88694-8519-4fb0-b8c9-c5a823084730
data.value: Your radical hostility concerns a commonly encountered group you choose. Social tests with its members take -6 dice; when negotiating with you, they gain +6 dice. This is situational, not a penalty to every social interaction.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b0640207-7965-4f1a-a28c-0dd5e24d2d8c
data.value: Your bias concerns a more narrowly defined group you choose. Social tests with its members take -2 dice; when negotiating with you, they gain +2 dice. This is situational, not a penalty to every social interaction.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.53ddd66b-ad89-43eb-9174-cbff6ed2a9c3
data.value: Your openly expressed prejudice concerns a more narrowly defined group you choose. Social tests with its members take -4 dice; when negotiating with you, they gain +4 dice. This is situational, not a penalty to every social interaction.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.100cf04a-51e5-477a-a57c-2dae699f7f04
data.value: Your radical hostility concerns a more narrowly defined group you choose. Social tests with its members take -6 dice; when negotiating with you, they gain +6 dice. This is situational, not a penalty to every social interaction.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.41cc3e26-ae55-4e28-bd6a-b08866c21424
data.value: Choose one Matrix action that requires a test. Add two dice whenever you perform that action. This does not improve all Matrix skills or actions that have no test.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.823eb204-c155-45a9-bb9a-98dcbe17a707
data.value: Choose one local benefit: ignore 2 background count; friendly neighbors and +2 Street Cred when negotiating with them; +2 Matrix dice in one host (lost after over six months away); +2 Evasion dice; +2 shelter-finding dice; or +2 local-gang knowledge dice. Only the selected benefit applies. Additional purchases choose another benefit.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8d558134-210d-4c96-b487-021a44409075
data.value: Agree on one natural disease or toxin with the GM. One exposure per 6 hours is harmless; further exposures cause normal damage with half-time recovery. Excludes magical agents. You can still transmit disease.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ce7634aa-0729-423d-bc38-d6f56416b904
data.value: Choose one synthetic disease or toxin, not all artificial agents. One exposure per 6 hours is harmless; further exposures cause normal damage with half-time recovery. Excludes magical agents. You can still carry infection.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c067baa6-0dfa-4783-a0c8-0873564f0308
data.value: Choose one spirit type, even outside your tradition. Spirits of that type are more helpful: gain one extra service from each and one die on Binding tests. This does not guarantee obedience or immunity to attack. Watchers and constructed minions are excluded.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8ec5c9bb-aeb9-42f2-a436-a60f764adfe4
data.value: See normally in partial or dim light. These lighting penalties disappear, but total darkness still blocks this sense. This is not heat vision and does not remove other visibility penalties.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.02e76a38-304e-4a0e-93a3-ad2938306afc
data.value: See infrared heat patterns. Improve Light and Visibility conditions by one step before determining their penalties. This is not a flat Perception bonus or immunity to darkness, fog or smoke; thermal smoke can defeat it.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0e741331-d776-4be8-abc5-4101228abdef
data.value: Enables Magic, Sorcery, Conjuring, Enchanting, astral perception and projection. Your creation option determines starting Magic and included skills or spells; this aptitude does not grant every skill, spell or adept Power Points.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4adeb2d4-e42e-4b7a-9a5d-3df325ae59a5
data.value: Choose exactly one group: Sorcery, Conjuring or Enchanting; the others remain unavailable. You can perceive astrally but cannot project. Counterspelling requires Sorcery. Starting Magic and skills depend on your creation option.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9e50dbab-8a5d-430e-83b0-731cce142848
data.value: This granted sense lets you perceive auras and astral beings and learn Assensing. Switching it on or off takes a Simple Action. While active, you are exposed to astral interaction and mundane physical tasks lose two dice. It does not grant astral projection. This catalog entry is a pixie trait, not a free adept-power purchase.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.59d9baa1-6705-49e8-940b-ea42ffc02692
data.value: An eligible Nosferatu can copy previously heard voices or other sounds. Copying an older memory requires a Memory test. Listeners detect the imitation with Perception; their required hits equal your hits on Charisma + Magic. This imitates sound, not the speaker's appearance. Existing holders cannot buy the same power again.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8dbc6b92-18a7-4007-b37f-295d21f8ab82
data.value: An eligible Nosferatu can sustain a telekinetic hand to move objects within sight. Activate it with a Complex Action and roll Magic + Willpower: the hits become the hand's Strength and Agility, not your own attributes. It does not grant unlimited lifting power. Existing holders cannot buy the same power again.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dda02333-10e3-4295-9392-691ff3a7bd4a
data.value: Agree on a binding moral code with the GM. A protection code forbids killing its chosen group or allowing their deaths; each protected death costs 1 adventure Karma. Charisma + Willpower (4) checks whether you can resist intervening when someone tries to kill them. Surviving witnesses can increase Public Awareness. Assassin and warrior variants instead restrict whom you may kill.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.69984296-4057-4a0f-964e-a0efb4bfc7ce
data.value: Choose a neurological aftereffect of IC or BTL: memory loss, blackouts, migraines or paranoia. Entering VR or using BTL requires Body + Willpower (4); failure triggers symptoms for 6 hours, a glitch for 24. Facing the responsible IC requires Willpower (3) against panic and imposes −2 dice to resist its damage. Removing this quality also requires medical treatment.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f446f88c-26aa-496a-aa78-ed478bf0875f
data.value: In the first Initiative Pass of a new combat, act before opponents with higher Initiative. Other Adrenaline Surge users and characters who spend Edge to seize initiative are ordered by their Initiative scores. Being surprised still prevents you from jumping ahead in an ambush; later passes use normal order.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cf3a62e1-8a41-413e-a679-30c8d1b5a0c1
data.value: The GM warns you before an action they judge foolish, up to your Edge rating in warnings per session. This is advice, not automatic success, immunity to consequences or extra dice; you still decide what to do.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d5eaa4c0-7f7c-4eb2-a708-bed460914d0a
data.value: When the GM rewards an exceptionally daring action with recovered Edge, recover 2 points instead of 1. This does not raise your Edge maximum or reward every risky action automatically; the GM decides what qualifies.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.75c24a3e-f5f9-47e4-947f-e461bac0e82f
data.value: Link this benefit to one real SIN or a fake SIN rated at least 4. Its data trail is confused with someone else's, raising the threshold of Matrix Searches tracking you through that identity by 2. Other identities are not protected; this does not improve the SIN's rating.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e30d8c76-968d-4f05-9635-5cb18ca43836
data.value: Your former authority still intimidates criminals despite your disgrace. Gain 2 dice to Intimidation against criminals the GM considers affected. Respectable citizens instead use a prejudiced attitude toward you in Etiquette tests. The bonus is not universal, and the social drawback remains.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.7a468691-1362-439a-a096-76da6933b24c
data.value: Gain low-light vision, but sensitive eyes also suffer blinding glare on clear days and moderate glare on overcast days. Sunglasses can reduce glare. Cyberware or bioware augmentation or replacement of these eyes removes the quality without a Karma refund. This is not unrestricted vision in total darkness.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.fd78fa11-5ab6-40db-bdb8-9fd722b08054
data.value: Gain 1 die on Performance tests involving rhythm or timing, plus one extra Free Action each Action Phase. You normally know the time to the minute, but isolation, unconsciousness or distorted time perception can disrupt that sense. The extra action is not a Simple or Complex Action.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9567f663-b56e-4038-9e15-78c963171fc6
data.value: Ritual spellcasting directed at you loses 2 dice when sealing the ritual. You also gain 2 dice on any resistance test against it. Both effects apply to friendly rituals too; this is not a general defense against ordinary spellcasting.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e518d74e-9e63-42fe-be47-2e37c461d21b
data.value: Your real family name carries influence in one chosen home sprawl. Minor local NPCs lose 2 dice on Social tests against you, and the family may smooth over minor offenses. Requires a national or full corporate SIN. The same recognizable identity also makes you easier to identify; it is not blanket legal immunity.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.16f138ec-2a6a-4cc3-a5a9-3c12b0fb9689
data.value: Choose one group, usually 1,000–5,000 members. Your reputation with it improves by 1; members are inclined to give you the benefit of the doubt. This is not a universal Street Cred or Social dice bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.da834cdb-bb3f-4866-a7f6-755d9d17c62b
data.value: Choose one group, usually 1,000–5,000 members. Your reputation with it improves by 2. This favorable standing is limited to that group; it grants neither universal fame nor bonus dice on every Social test.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c0f1c43c-7e50-4a84-ad0d-a0bc28f77836
data.value: Read roughly 800 words in five seconds while grasping the general meaning. This does not automatically memorize the text. Searching for a specific detail uses an extended Logic + Intuition test; the GM sets its threshold and interval to suit the text and the information sought.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.60972204-7dc5-4882-be7d-781f533dabef
data.value: Each level adds 1 die to resist harmful biofeedback damage, up to 3 levels. This includes damage from black IC and dumpshock. It is not extra Matrix armor, a larger damage monitor or a bonus to every Matrix defense test.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.af460f42-c0d2-4f7d-8b80-8e71d19b5aac
data.value: Spirits gain 1 extra die to resist your Summoning. If you succeed, the summoned spirit arrives at Force one higher than declared; the summoning itself still uses the declared Force. This does not give you an extra Summoning die or an extra service.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3fd458df-fd47-4c62-9235-1af27eed2928
data.value: Reduce terrain modifiers on Vehicle tests by 1, never below 0. This eases difficult terrain; it does not create a bonus on clear terrain or increase your vehicle's Handling or Speed.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.84d4acee-d58a-43dc-bea7-90cb133fbc76
data.value: Fatigue damage occurs twice as often. Effects accumulate: at 1 box, −1 die on Physical actions and −1 Social Limit; at 2, another −1 die on all actions and −1 Social Limit; at 4, resist further Fatigue using only Willpower; at 8, another −1 on all action pools and Social Limit.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5c5dd94f-8ad2-4fb2-bbe6-26d18e0da436
data.value: Agree a serious past mistake with the GM. Against people who know it, your Social Limit drops by 3 and the secret can invite blackmail. You cannot buy this quality off while it stays secret. Public exposure adds 1 Notoriety and requires buying it off as soon as possible.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.81f51f6b-672f-477b-b84a-10b602d714e0
data.value: Visual Perception automatically fails; general Perception loses 4 dice and Surprise loses 3. Ranged attacks use Blind Fire, melee uses Total Darkness. Cybereyes cannot fix this neurological blindness. Astral perception remains possible if you possess it, with the usual −2 dice for physical-plane actions; it is not ordinary sight.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.56ed0031-cf9b-427c-978f-0a766ac2181d
data.value: Your character faces an unpredictable death. At each session's start the GM secretly rolls 3 dice: any triple means death during that session. Ordinary Karma buyoff is unavailable. Only when that result occurs may the GM allow survival by permanently burning all current Edge, removing this quality.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cf66af29-b4ff-4931-bc0b-5c5b6006e978
data.value: Below Middle Lifestyle: −1 on Social and Healing tests per tier below Middle, applicable each day spent there.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d63f2467-1b76-4f7b-adef-bfced240109e
data.value: Below High Lifestyle: −1 on Social and Healing tests per tier below High, applicable each day spent there.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.bf0f580e-ca90-40e7-8ca1-018bacad9bbc
data.value: Below Luxury Lifestyle: −1 on Social and Healing tests per tier below Luxury, applicable each day spent there.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8bca877e-42e5-4ff7-92ec-4c83f4cadb86
data.value: You habitually hide insults in conversation. Whenever you roll a glitch on a Social test, treat it as a critical glitch, even if the roll also has hits. This does not turn an ordinary unsuccessful roll into a glitch or penalize unrelated tests.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4d435a24-f8f9-456d-83c1-6fecb217cf67
data.value: Choose an overriding personal quest. A relevant clue requires Willpower + Logic (4) to avoid abandoning everything to pursue it, even at allies' expense. While actively following a lead, Willpower increases by 1. That bonus is conditional, not a permanent attribute increase.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.fae6e95c-f71b-47e5-8cb4-696f2af2bf22
data.value: Choose cherished gear: you insist on using it and take dangerous risks to recover it. If it is permanently lost or destroyed, buy off the quality immediately or suffer −1 on tests that would use it for six months. Afterward, the attachment transfers to replacement gear.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9056baa6-ed79-4f28-a199-36093d99555f
data.value: Agree a trigger with the GM, occurring about every other run. On exposure, Composure (5) prevents incapacitation; failure means no useful action for 5 − hits Combat Turns.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.41d447d7-5ea0-45f9-8b9d-16b5c9ec8937
data.value: Agree a trigger with the GM, occurring at least once each session. On exposure, Composure (5) prevents incapacitation; failure means no useful action for 5 − hits Combat Turns.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b86cdb32-7c3a-404b-94c1-cafe8ccad060
data.value: You refuse accommodation above Squatter Lifestyle. Being forced into better lodging reduces every Mental attribute by 2 until you spend a full day at Squatter or Street level again. This is a temporary attribute reduction, not merely a Social-test penalty.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dca0897f-532a-43ab-8796-4ef761e829af
data.value: Your legs are paralyzed; other physical tasks remain possible. Wheelchair movement is Agility ×3 walking, ×4 running, but stairs impede access. Lifestyle costs rise 10%; vehicles need 5% modifications or a rigger interface for DNI control. Astral and Matrix abilities are unaffected. Successful corrective surgery also requires buying off this quality.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3e255d71-c126-40a6-a6f6-44bd17d019e4
data.value: You leave a recognizable calling card after jobs. Investigators identifying your handiwork or tracking you gain a dice-pool modifier equal to your Street Cred plus Public Awareness. Choose the mark with the GM; it is evidence linking you to the job, not a bonus to your own reputation.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cb3afab7-03ab-400f-bb67-5a854b24418b
data.value: Cybereye-compatible reduced grade. Your skin remains sun-sensitive: halve the interval between sun-exposure resistance tests. Replacing your eyes does not remove this remaining drawback.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.30eb56ed-b154-4748-a11f-415f03392113
data.value: Indoor light or bright overcast causes Weak Glare; sunshine causes Moderate Glare. Other glare worsens one step; normal protection helps. Sun-resistance intervals halve. Later cybereyes require buying down to the reduced grade before other Karma spending.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1209249d-4600-46a7-833c-87d14f719b5e
data.value: Your past is missing, but practical abilities remain. The GM keeps hidden Knowledge skills: recovering a listed skill costs 2 Karma and adds one rank; newly learned skills cost normally.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1f03322a-ef16-4495-9bdb-824006c41aad
data.value: Agree GM-led play with hidden Mental attributes, skills, qualities and Edge. Your past and parts of creation are GM-controlled. Full control returns after Karma buyoff and the GM's story goals.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8fc3e769-ea71-41e1-968c-600d507cdf94
data.value: 10 hours/week, ¥1,000/month. Requires a SIN (fake 4+). Repeated absence risks dismissal, −2 Street Cred and one month's salary.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4294e480-4299-41e5-9336-50a98ec14bbf
data.value: 20 hours/week, ¥2,500/month. Requires a SIN (fake 4+). Repeated absence risks dismissal, −2 Street Cred and one month's salary.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.12b6f08b-5513-4dfd-840d-fd43595d15b8
data.value: 40 hours/week, ¥5,000/month. Requires a SIN (fake 4+). Repeated absence risks dismissal, −2 Street Cred and one month's salary.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2b4dd1b1-b806-44e3-9067-65dc39c82d13
data.value: Each level supplies ¥5,000 at creation instead of ordinary Karma-for-cash, up to 15 levels. You owe 150% of the loan, with 10% monthly interest. Missing the interest payment causes 1 unresisted Physical box per ¥20,000 owed, unhealable until paid. Repayment is required in both cases: Karma buyoff or an equal-value replacement drawback.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.43cab487-f5f7-4fc1-bc61-c011c3aa3a67
data.value: Stress, injury or combat can reactivate an old cover identity. Make Composure (4); failure lets that identity take over for 1D6 minutes or a GM-set duration. Your runner identity and its skills become unavailable during this state. Further stress can trigger another switch; the GM handles the alternate identity.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.136cb6e9-0353-4324-9671-1ee176c5aeef
data.value: Lose 2 dice on all Perception tests, including astral and Matrix perception. This grade does not raise their thresholds. It changes test pools, not learned skill ratings.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.26fe2c36-f6cc-4f97-ae1b-5d5eb3be2315
data.value: Lose 2 dice on all Perception tests, including astral and Matrix perception, and increase their thresholds by 1. Both drawbacks apply; this is not a four-dice penalty.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3b2624fe-1d4d-47ba-a663-3ca21323f28c
data.value: No assassination jobs. Violence, including nonlethal attacks, only to defend against an ongoing attack on you, allies or bystanders.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ab5142e6-c8d7-4035-86da-dcdcc2fa46cc
data.value: Never use violence. Violation: −1 on Mental-attribute tests; recover with extended Charisma + Willpower (20, daily). Seven-day failure permanently lowers the higher attribute by 1, ending that penalty. Killing, even mistakenly believed: −2 dice, weekly recovery, Mental Limit −1.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ce01db25-465b-4d13-b091-055496f3a5c4
data.value: Each level means another Big Ten megacorporation holds your identity, biometric and medical records, up to ten. Its agents gain 2 dice to identify you from those records, and to locate you in security zones C or better. The bonus belongs to investigators, not you. Incompatible with Erased.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.04b68abc-0f9d-4fe9-8b41-82d7b9c95e2e
data.value: Dense augmented-reality input or sensory enhancements can overwhelm you. Make Willpower + Edge (4); failure causes a seizure lasting 5 − hits minutes. Disabling enhancements or switching the commlink off/hidden may prevent exposure, but concealing required identity broadcasts can attract attention. This is not merely a permanent Perception penalty.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1e3d8aff-c31c-41f9-8c62-e3332cac79fa
data.value: Agree with the GM who wants you and why. A bounty or contract of at least ¥25,000 draws repeated hunters and people exploiting the reward, potentially including associates. Removing the bounty does not erase the quality for free: you must also buy it off with Karma.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3659b016-5511-4cdb-a9f3-ce2ecfba4513
data.value: A rare trigger frightens you. While exposed, all actions lose 1 die.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.255ba2d3-6fbd-4b89-8131-c10f96e70d32
data.value: Rare trigger: all actions lose 3 dice while exposed. Composure (2) is needed to avoid fleeing.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e929cc4a-0973-4c55-9ca9-a925b0d7d463
data.value: Rare trigger: all actions lose 6 dice while exposed. Failed Composure (5) forces flight for at least 5 − hits Combat Turns.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ff42593b-e1da-406e-aa10-cd90ef2629f5
data.value: A frequent trigger frightens you. While exposed, all actions lose 1 die.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1c293ee1-c2e3-4e82-9ee6-91425955f250
data.value: Frequent trigger: all actions lose 3 dice while exposed. Composure (2) is needed to avoid fleeing.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.10b0e391-6cb4-46ba-a357-570ffa2eba69
data.value: Frequent trigger: all actions lose 6 dice while exposed. Failed Composure (5) forces flight for at least 5 − hits Combat Turns.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5adbea9d-7b48-4bc9-9941-31df54b02804
data.value: You exaggerate to outdo others' achievements. Composure (3) lets you stop boasting before someone demands proof.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.68399920-e3ff-4d17-a69a-0265c57422ab
data.value: Composure (2) lets you reject the riskiest option. The rush grants +1 Initiative Score for 5 Combat Turns, not an extra die or +1 each turn.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.62de8226-b9a9-4065-9e82-b9ac4d4d027a
data.value: Slights demand escalating revenge. Composure (2) prevents immediate retaliation, but you still plan to settle the score later.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.83e2a9b7-e06e-494e-95d3-c6e554d9928e
data.value: Once fighting, you keep going until every opponent is incapacitated. Composure (3) lets you withdraw even when outnumbered or losing.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f356d63f-1782-4952-aca2-bc04e2cd6c60
data.value: Natural eyesight adds 1 die to Perception and treats range penalties as one category nearer. Incompatible with electronic vision enhancements or cyberware/bioware eye augmentation or replacement.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f8f216b5-1c29-467d-9fb5-c9812408203d
data.value: Choose Artisan or Performance: that skill gains 1 die. Your Street Cred increases by 2 only among artists who know your reputation. Choose this quality once; it does not grant a specialization.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.624fa943-c0a1-44ee-8cd8-3aef4bea3f4b
data.value: After creation, each Active or Knowledge skill increase to rating 5 or lower costs 1 less Karma, minimum 1. Increases to rating 6 or higher cost 2 extra Karma. No creation discount.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3564b678-7721-4a8d-ac79-1600cf92dc14
data.value: Unaugmented reflexes give +1 Initiative rating, +1 Initiative die and +1 die to Defense tests. The Initiative benefits do not stack with technological, chemical or magical enhancements.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d6c7389c-d6cf-42b1-b3f2-3466d5a5d485
data.value: Languages take half as long to learn and gain 1 die on tests. At creation, language points buy twice as much. In Career, each language increase to rating 3 or higher costs 1 less Karma.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dc7a0c59-5f9c-4ba9-8b63-aaf442472673
data.value: A contact with Connection 3+ teaches for free; the GM defines the relationship. Choose one skill (teacher rating 13; Instruction 10 dice, limit 7) or group (rating 12; Instruction 12 dice, limit 8). These are the teacher's ratings, not free ranks for you.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0334f054-7d44-443c-a14b-372ba86ff03f
data.value: Skills in the Influence group gain 1 die. Your Social Limit rises by 2 only when the situation involves trusting you, not for every Social test.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f8af38e2-e79a-44f9-8e72-57aba35b7056
data.value: Single-target direct combat spells deal 2 more damage but cause 2 more Drain. This does not improve indirect or area spells. Requires the Magician or Aspected Magician quality.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.df4cfe8b-3394-4ac8-b5c8-fda04701de17
data.value: You cannot read; helpers or text-to-speech can assist. Social Limit −1 with people who know this; −2 dice using others' electronics, not your own. Reading-dependent Knowledge skills are unavailable at creation and cost double Karma afterward until you learn to read and buy off this quality.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.fc31eb53-28a3-46cb-af10-982fca829e34
data.value: You hear nothing: audio-only Perception automatically fails. General Perception loses 2 dice; Surprise loses 3. The GM can apply further situational penalties.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.6a0a61f0-4b14-410e-9c3c-4c88a4592277
data.value: Contacts shun you, and new connections withdraw. Discover the GM's hidden reason and resolve it; then buy off this drawback or replace it with one of equal value.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dab93ad4-bc28-4f67-a3f7-209ba893c7fb
data.value: Light/glare penalties count as one category worse; full light without glare remains penalty-free. Incompatible with other eye-related qualities. Corrective cyberware or bioware requires buying off this drawback first; without enough Karma, you cannot obtain that correction.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4e2763ca-e042-4cad-996b-1b472c5426ca
data.value: Distrust costs 2 dice on Social tests with unfamiliar people or contacts whose Loyalty is below 4. You conceal where you live and must relocate every few months. This is not a penalty when dealing with trusted, familiar people.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.34965554-9252-4b37-b40b-c904e8034d03
data.value: Name the person or group in your feud. Encountering that enemy requires Composure (3); failure makes you provoke violence. Defeating the enemy does not erase the drawback: buy it off, or a new enemy continues the feud.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.eeb2ed52-dd4a-4961-83e2-d707530ed193
data.value: Grants High Pain Tolerance 1, but each day begins with 1 Physical damage box. Healing is possible; the character's compulsion seeks to restore that damage.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8fa3b253-1e6f-439d-940e-f48a1d8959c8
data.value: HMHVV-II carrier: bodily-fluid exposure requires disease resistance. Immune only to this strain. Social tests lose 2 dice against people aware of your status. Notoriety increases by 1 per strain.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3fc02bdc-1f3f-448c-8e8c-d1869ac4fcfc
data.value: HMHVV-III carrier: bodily-fluid exposure requires disease resistance. Immune only to this strain. Social tests lose 2 dice against people aware of your status. Notoriety increases by 1 per strain.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.6509ce7a-a453-4941-9bfa-ec0fe48c6d40
data.value: See in every direction: +1 die for visual Perception and Surprise. Tests while moving lose 1 die; ranged attacks beyond 10 metres lose another 1, cumulatively. The unusual eyes cannot be augmented or replaced without losing this trait and may attract social prejudice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f368f4c5-6d8e-4bf0-9567-f6ba8367678f
data.value: A second heart doubles the time between fatigue damage from exertion or extreme temperatures. It does not add dice to Athletics. A synthacardium can augment the primary heart only.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8c434958-fce8-45d3-88a5-b0f6f8ca58b0
data.value: Hear infrasound below normal hearing; sound-based Perception limit +1. Always active, with no frequency filter: otherwise inaudible noise can overwhelm you. Incompatible with earware.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.bbabf58c-e3b7-49c0-be8f-29f7d8011814
data.value: Hear ultrasound above normal hearing; sound-based Perception limit +1. Always active, with no frequency filter: otherwise inaudible noise can overwhelm you. Incompatible with earware.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cb8ee404-fe6d-4697-9adf-1e41b14355cb
data.value: Skin copies contrasting backgrounds after 1 minute: observers lose 2 visual Perception dice while you remain still and clothing does not spoil concealment. Lasts up to 4 hours; changed surroundings make it fade within 10 minutes. No other dermal modifications.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.02a5832b-6521-4be0-a025-f320e345ca81
data.value: Skin follows background colours: observers lose 2 visual Perception dice while you move, 4 while still. Clothing must preserve concealment. Incompatible with other dermal modifications.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.195f183e-8c42-49cb-bfce-fe84bb9a9964
data.value: Breathe air and water. Air-adapted gills halve fatigue-test intervals underwater; breathing air has no added fatigue penalty.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d10f48e4-5587-4ecf-ba8e-f7de16fe6a2a
data.value: Breathe air and water. Water-adapted gills halve fatigue-test intervals in air; breathing underwater has no added fatigue penalty.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1cf04f79-0d0a-4c61-b166-d1c95b78ebfb
data.value: Breathe air or water equally well, switching automatically. Unlike the partial gill variants, neither environment shortens fatigue-test intervals.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.35103093-5f41-4d42-a2b5-6fbb64f627b1
data.value: Supernatural presence encourages friendly reactions while you remain non-hostile. Social limit +2; Social skill tests gain 1 die, except Intimidation. You also gain Distinctive Style: people remember you, making identification and pursuit easier.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.32c427cf-2f0b-4cbc-a1bd-5dc97ba5e9c6
data.value: Enlarged ears sharpen hearing: gain 1 die on sound-based Perception tests. This is a hearing bonus, not a bonus to every kind of perception.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2f080d13-92d7-4b16-9ee6-93b5a89206e4
data.value: Natural, ordinary-looking eyes see clearly even by starlight. This is low-light vision, not sight in total darkness. Incompatible with replacement eyes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.210401d7-57fa-4260-9517-2725689a509e
data.value: Reflective catlike eyes see clearly by starlight, but their slit pupils make your altered appearance obvious and can affect social encounters. Not sight in total darkness; incompatible with replacement eyes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.fd346177-3791-44c0-af8c-7cf176fc9aa3
data.value: Grants natural heat-sensitive vision, like that of a dwarf or troll. Use thermographic visibility conditions; this is not an unconditional Perception bonus or the ability to see through walls.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4390735f-54fa-44a5-bce7-d23a67427f25
data.value: A protective eye membrane lets you see underwater as though wearing swimming goggles or a diving mask. Water clarity and lighting still matter; this does not grant underwater breathing.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1d9239a1-0e58-4779-873d-5b8677865806
data.value: Arctic adaptation: Survival and climate-fatigue resistance gain 1 die in extreme cold, but lose 1 in desert heat. Incompatible with dermal plating, skin modifications and a suprathyroid gland.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.850ac6a8-4264-4b7f-bf75-04e1c768b411
data.value: Desert adaptation: Survival and climate-fatigue resistance gain 1 die in desert heat, but lose 1 in extreme cold. Incompatible with dermal plating, skin modifications and a suprathyroid gland.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.3e80d1e0-ae6a-4059-8a49-ae97547b3384
data.value: Adhesive palms let you use assisted climbing speeds whenever your hands are uncovered. Gloves block this benefit. You still make the required climbing tests; this does not guarantee success.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9b8a9ecc-295f-4764-b5d8-0a3fb317d9b8
data.value: Gripping toes give +2 dice for non-tumbling Gymnastics, climbing and zero-gravity movement. Use bare feet or adapted footwear; ordinary, unsuitable shoes reduce the bonus to +1.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.51027aca-c1db-470a-afa4-d28cc219152f
data.value: A natural chest or belly pouch stores small items like a smuggling compartment, with Concealability −6. It helps hide the contents; it does not make them impossible to discover.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.67767d53-56f0-4b66-b7ef-5ff6319ea551
data.value: Sense electrical sources within Essence metres. Simple Action: Perception + Intuition [Mental], affected by Noise. More hits distinguish source type, location, augmentation and orientation.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.54c7952d-24b2-489e-9597-3430dfff6207
data.value: Sense wireless signals within Essence metres. Simple Action: Perception + Intuition [Mental], affected by Noise. More hits reveal devices, nanites or technomancers; this grants no control over them.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.493450e1-b88b-441b-b7ee-bdecf5a99d2d
data.value: A grasping trunk uses your unaugmented Strength; handling objects costs 2 dice. Attack with Exotic Melee Weapon (Trunk): damage (Strength − 1) Physical, no added Reach, AP +1. No extra attack; its conspicuous appearance can affect social encounters.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.bf416ac2-75b2-4907-8b15-1447784b5851
data.value: Animals and paranormal critters within 5 metres react fearfully or aggressively. Tests to control, calm or pacify them lose 2 dice. In combat, critters prefer attacking you.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.acd06d4f-7f09-4d80-8bab-006b680392a2
data.value: A single eye retains your natural vision but lacks depth perception. Combat tests lose 1 die; the GM also applies this to precision-dependent Physical or Technical skills. A cybereye cannot restore binocular processing. Incompatible with Third Eye; visible differences can affect social encounters.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ddc04b8e-b0f7-485d-9ab7-dee1110133fd
data.value: Displaced facial features: −2 Perception dice. Double the usual metagenic social modifiers. Surgical correction requires buying off this drawback first.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.35279341-3611-439a-9550-8227b306198f
data.value: Conspicuous feathers provide no armour. Others gain 1 die on Matrix searches and tests to identify or locate you. Your appearance can provoke prejudice. Incompatible with Scales and Unusual Hair.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.7618be2b-b4c1-4f7c-905b-7698cc2e744e
data.value: Insectlike features provide no flight or improved vision. Strangers begin Hostile, fearing insect spirits; combatants may target you first. Others gain 1 die on Matrix searches and tests to identify or locate you.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0ece5812-aa89-484b-b899-f02ac961a417
data.value: Your hair changes colour with your emotions. Observers who understand the colours gain 2 dice to Judge Intentions against you. Incompatible with other hair modifications, Feathers and Scales.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b0887f45-c0b1-4a5c-bd17-d73450287621
data.value: Your body favours night or twilight activity and daytime sleep. During daylight hours, all Mental attributes decrease by 1, not just test dice. Incompatible with Photometabolism.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.873d8045-853f-4797-9f08-1a1eac388af0
data.value: Obvious scales shed periodically but provide no armour. Others gain 2 dice on Matrix searches and tests to identify or locate you. Your appearance can provoke prejudice. Incompatible with bioware skin augmentations and other skin-related qualities.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b0152c5a-b959-43f2-825e-801e5ac07466
data.value: A strong odour clings to your clothing. Others gain 1 die to locate you by scent, or 2 when you are stressed. Unmasked odour costs you 1 die on Social tests, or 2 under stress. Perfume can mask the ordinary smell.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c57c9407-7ac6-4061-abab-7735c8bd69b4
data.value: Obvious skin colours or patterns make you memorable and can provoke prejudice. Others gain 2 dice on Matrix searches and tests to identify or locate you. Incompatible with bioware skin augmentations.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dba6c764-3851-4d8e-97ce-344f45c8d771
data.value: A forehead eye gives no general vision bonus, but preserves depth perception when one eye closes. Even closed, it can be noticed with Perception (2). Incompatible with Cyclopean Eye; your appearance can affect social encounters.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.69a61e8c-238e-4ef9-8847-6271ed260a62
data.value: Unusual hair colour, texture or growth makes you conspicuous. Others gain 1 die on Matrix searches and tests to identify or locate you. Incompatible with natural or artificial hair modifications.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4e35cd80-5a2e-431b-aafc-5a39a9e17f38
data.value: A nonfunctional tail disrupts balance: lose 1 die on Physical tests involving movement or balance, such as jumping, climbing and running. Incompatible with Functional Tail or artificial tails. Your appearance can provoke prejudice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8236f10b-345c-44f5-b0b1-648004f24d3f
data.value: Your aura creates background count 3 within Essence metres, hindering magic around you, including your own. Staying in place can expand it by 1 metre every 4 hours, at the GM's discretion. The expansion cap is unclear; agree it with the GM.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.95ba1f65-34c0-4f6e-9440-40e860278342
data.value: Emotional agitation can trigger a GM-called Composure (3) test. Failure causes uncontrollable rage for 1D6 Combat Turns: attack anyone nearby, including friends. Physical attributes +1; Mental attributes −1, minimum 1. Rage always triggers an implanted adrenaline pump.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.96b4cfc7-ddf6-4828-8393-7625b0564bd1
data.value: Your skin or hair glows in dim light or darkness, reducing others' visibility penalty to spot you by 1 level. If you have low-light vision, the glow also improves your nearby visibility by 1 level. Normal lighting hides the glow.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8b0eb8a7-fc44-4452-bfd6-db8ee531bc0d
data.value: A soft, tentacled head and upper torso lose 3 dice when resisting damage to those regions. This is not a penalty to every damage-resistance test. The conspicuous appearance can affect social encounters.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.006409d3-cc04-4195-8569-b81d73ccb1a2
data.value: Cold impairs tests using Physical attributes: below 30°C, −1 die; below 20°C, −3; below 10°C, −5. Use the applicable penalty, not their sum. At 0°C you become comatose until warmed. Observers relying solely on heat vision or thermal sensitivity lose 2 dice to detect or attack you.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.33a1a0ed-20b8-4ddd-9070-2b460a5455b7
data.value: Long residence binds you within Essence × 100 metres: monthly Body + Willpower (3), −1 die if resisting. Locally: Outdoors +1 die; peaceful neighbourhoods give healing +1 die. Local troubles cause persistent Mild Allergy. Moving requires a successful new test after a month. Local Social modifier unspecified: agree with the GM.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.31108c89-a67c-47d4-a757-db4e22e2f607
data.value: Choose a manufacturer: tests using its gear gain 1 die; tests using other manufacturers' gear lose 1 die. This covers the maker's range, not just one product.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.348d7043-7a1c-498f-85eb-3339be9941d1
data.value: Choose a product model: tests using it gain 1 die; other models of the same equipment type lose 1 die. Unrelated equipment types are unaffected.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.98644894-e3a4-41f2-9b7e-91feb74d0334
data.value: Learn one chosen martial-arts technique without learning its associated style. This grants the technique, not an entire style or every technique in it. The chosen move's effects still depend on that technique.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1675810d-0f77-42f9-848a-eaa929cb3a20
data.value: Called Shot penalties are reduced by 2 dice. All other Ranged Attack actions lose 1 die. Precision shots improve at the expense of ordinary shooting; this is not a general ranged-attack bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.da4f7e4a-0e7e-45e6-a872-643bdecb183e
data.value: Radiation environments count 1 severity step lower for fatigue. Deadly radiation uses Extreme fatigue severity but retains Deadly exposure intervals. You carry contamination for twice as long after exposure, endangering others. Incompatible with Rad-Tolerant.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.01bba489-52a2-4a80-845e-61905a970626
data.value: Double the exposure time before developing Blighted. Radiation environments count 1 severity step lower for fatigue. This is resistance, not radiation immunity; it cannot be combined with Radiation Sponge.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8826405e-a995-4687-b7c8-4e1e51fef3f0
data.value: Physical actions gain 1 die whenever gravity differs from normal Earth gravity. No bonus in ordinary terrestrial gravity, and no bonus to unrelated Mental actions.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8d2b32ec-2ddf-40dd-a29b-bf2e85a3d8ca
data.value: Stress requires Composure (4) to avoid starting a fight. When a plan is disrupted unexpectedly, Intuition + Logic (4) is needed to think before resorting to violence. You may choose violence without rolling, accepting its consequences.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f810fb60-8e1f-4111-a4f3-b652e91693ca
data.value: Session-start Edge (3), no Edge spending. Failure: Physical actions −1 die this session; success: no penalty. Requires relevant environmental exposure or GM approval.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.94cbe9bc-fabc-4126-81f8-3e31c7ed85f8
data.value: Session-start Edge (3), no Edge spending. Failure: all actions −1 die this session; success: no penalty. Requires relevant environmental exposure or GM approval.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.6be0022f-f8c8-4c51-808c-d339d3e8fecb
data.value: Session-start Edge (3), no Edge spending. Failure: Physical actions −2 dice, others −1 this session; success: no penalty. Requires relevant environmental exposure or GM approval.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e7c16580-6705-4a93-a9be-dbea90efd2eb
data.value: Physical actions lose 2 dice when gravity differs from normal Earth gravity. No penalty under ordinary terrestrial gravity. If your campaign does not encounter altered gravity, taking this drawback requires GM approval.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ab72b0fb-5a64-4d5e-9e23-2fdf548a7f53
data.value: Chase Actions gain 2 dice, whether you are pursuing another vehicle or trying to escape. This improves chase tests, not every driving roll or the vehicle's Speed attribute.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ef6796eb-6559-4f22-bfa6-7e6571a3690d
data.value: Choose ground vehicles, watercraft, aircraft or drones: purchases in that class cost 10% less, after Availability-based price adjustments. May be bought once per class, up to 4 times. It does not make unavailable vehicles obtainable.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1b40cda8-97e1-40bf-827b-0d38c3ba6dfc
data.value: Tests using skills in the Engineering group gain 1 die. This helps mechanical work without increasing learned skill ratings, giving free repairs or improving every Technical skill.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5bcfc0fc-1e46-4ba9-a48c-7b623e9ab8db
data.value: Pilot tests gain 1 die while travelling at Speed 3 or higher, or 4 for aircraft. You must be inside the vehicle or jacked in; ordinary remote piloting does not qualify. This does not increase the vehicle's maximum speed.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.fe34b084-2368-4f8d-bb91-689ee22e9380
data.value: Vehicle Stunt tests gain 2 dice. The bonus is for stunt manoeuvres with vehicles, not every Pilot test or attacks made from a vehicle.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.311421e2-a71e-4f06-a15a-9fbc53247376
data.value: Choose a Pilot skill: while you control a matching vehicle, observers lose 2 dice on Perception tests to spot it. Drones qualify only under your direct control, not autonomous software. May be taken once per Pilot skill, including individual Exotic Craft skills.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9038578e-6a7c-43d7-ae51-324738a1a9d1
data.value: Vehicle motion causes Nausea at effective Acceleration 3 or higher—crossing that many range categories—or Speed 4 or higher. After motion drops below the triggering level, recovery takes (12 − Body) minutes. The drawback affects passengers too, not only drivers.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.22c624b8-89f4-4c0d-ab19-c84ca204e2a5
data.value: Directing 4 or more moving vehicles or drones overwhelms you: Pilot tests for their movement lose 2 dice. Autopilot-controlled units still count because their incoming data distracts you. Stationary units do not trigger this rule.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.237eb46a-a012-4e0b-808a-80eda1c1a586
data.value: Learn magical tattooing in 2 weeks. Existing Artificing can create tattoo foci; existing Quickening or Anchoring can attach spells to tattoos. This technique does not grant those skills or metamagics, nor a free focus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.34d7e834-4fbe-49b1-86e8-a9ff354fd972
data.value: Spirits respond favourably to you. For Summoning, spending Force × 5 drams of reagents grants +1 die, separate from reagents used to set the limit. Binding needs only Force × 20 drams and gains +1 die.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.94a4cc04-d856-418f-ac60-165f327433d5
data.value: Spirits distrust you. Summoning requires Force × 5 additional drams of reagents; without them it fails automatically. Reagents setting the limit do not cover this cost. Binding requires Force × 30 drams and loses 1 die.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.a8747e12-08b1-4665-8e48-23c30c047be6
data.value: Choose Stabilization, Diagnosis or Treatment: gain +1 die on that task under the optional advanced medical rules, using mundane or magical methods. Choose only one task; this is not a bonus to all healing and cannot be taken repeatedly.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.97e9b186-8924-4885-a948-3c781244a5cb
data.value: Experience comes at a physical cost. Each level grants 5 Knowledge Skill points and lowers the natural maximum of Body, Strength, Agility and Reaction by 1. Up to 3 levels. These are maximum reductions, not a flat penalty to every current attribute or test.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.03d5c621-7883-492e-988b-5aafdebc855d
data.value: Halve Called Shot dice penalties; the Free Action cost remains. You must use Called Shots, except for covering fire or similar actions where they are impractical. This does not halve weapon damage or grant free attacks.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.efd34715-a95c-41d5-ae81-f3b394246448
data.value: Concealability −1 for items hidden on your person, up to half your Agility rounded up. This makes them harder to notice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8b686f85-1ef6-4369-a8ad-31eeb64985e9
data.value: Choose an element: matching spells gain +2 casting dice. Their Drain takes that elemental form, including its secondary effects.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9410a544-e13e-4de8-b5bf-7bfe316b70ac
data.value: Toxins you use gain +1 Power. This does not increase your resistance to poison.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.fb9eab85-ae9a-4d03-8c3f-70b6a32d5e17
data.value: Faith helps you ignore wound penalties. After taking damage, roll Willpower at each Action Phase's start; the threshold is accumulated wounds and rises with further damage. Success suppresses penalties; failure restores them and disables this benefit until next combat. Acting against your faith requires Charisma + Willpower, with severity-dependent difficulty; failure means refusing and trying to stop others.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.86b95cd9-6c29-481e-9f75-cbb4aaf98f03
data.value: Only take killing contracts against people you judge deserving; never intentionally kill others. Agree criteria with the GM. Accidental undeserved killing: lose 1 Karma; −1 die on Mental tests for 24 hours.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.48e7351a-3d47-48d4-a969-cc5943d29da0
data.value: An exposed face makes you uneasy: −2 dice on Social tests unless disguised beyond recognition or concealed. No penalty with trusted friends, family or teammates.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d537536d-893d-4bd6-89c6-03b7dd5bd24c
data.value: Chronic illness. Test Body + Body (3), or (2) with treatment; failure penalizes all tests. Mild: monthly, −1 die, ¥1000/month. Moderate: weekly, −2, ¥500/week. Severe: daily, −3, ¥100/day. The GM may allow a permanent cure for 12 times the monthly treatment cost.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.08cceb0d-4fbe-44c8-97ca-e9ec24b692df
data.value: At creation only. Cumulative trimester effects: first, −1 die on all tests after 1 hour without food; second, strenuous activity adds 1 unresisted Stun per Body Combat Turns (each Complex Action resting removes 1 fatigue box); third, −1 to all Physical attributes until birth. After birth, replace this with Dependents or other suitable drawbacks worth 9 Karma.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.204d2317-77cd-448c-9506-091269d1e58a
data.value: Loyalty to your country sustains you through wounds. After taking damage, roll Willpower at each Action Phase's start against accumulated wounds; further damage increases the threshold. Success suppresses wound penalties; failure restores them and disables this benefit until next combat. Harming your country requires Charisma + Willpower, with severity-dependent difficulty; failure means refusing and trying to stop others.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.aaac8dfd-dee6-4277-b967-9ec9089260a7
data.value: Accept only betaware or better; at least 1 Essence already spent on qualifying cyberware/bioware. Creation restrictions still apply.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.37129686-fe48-4374-acca-7b06d1373db0
data.value: With implants and Essence ≤5: −2 dice resisting disease, toxins, drugs and physical addiction.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.6b9c009f-613b-4d3f-82c6-53e191c4e095
data.value: Killing causes no remorse. +1 melee die; halve suppressive-fire penalties; Etiquette/Leadership −2. Retreat against Professional Rating 5+ requires Composure (3). Incompatible with any Code of Honor.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dc510f9d-0648-474b-8016-11a810ada098
data.value: A human with elven, dwarven, ork or troll features gains +1 die when disguising as that chosen metatype. Cosmetic resemblance does not change your metatype or attribute limits. This catalog requires SURGE.
